name: Kanto Life
description: Unified Kanto Life for Gen1, Gen2, and Gen3 including FireRed/LeafGreen/Emerald: continuous ambient movement, route/door routines, Gen3 dialogue and interaction events, NPC collision bubbles, and voxel-safe sleep props. Yellow keeps the engine-native local walker active and uses the controller for route/door travel; Gen3 uses native profile-specific Game3 graphics and world handles.
